crossRefs.note: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any…
We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and…

translations.web: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
translations.bsb: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred.
translations.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred
translations.asv: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
